vessel-dome-base: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Time Capsule vessel layer PNG. Image 1 is the ASSEMBLED DOME EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE. Create the BASE layer only from Image 1. Keep only the complete brass pedestal base at the bottom, including its top oval platform and all brass rims, at precisely the same pixel position, size, perspective, colors, ink lines, and hatching as Image 1. Remove the blue rose, stem, leaves, glass dome, glass highlights, glass outline, and top brass finial completely. Everything outside the complete base must be genuinely transparent alpha 0, including all four corners. Preserve exactly the original square canvas and registration. Do not move, resize, repaint, or reinterpret the base. No text or logos. Match Image 2's hand-inked storybook style with the lighter hatching already present in Image 1. The final image must overlay Image 1 pixel-for-pixel where the base is visible.
